title: Diya Making Workshop
summary: A Diya Painting Workshop was conducted at KES SSC English Medium School on 14 October 2026 for 75 students of Grades 7 and 8.
description: A Diya Painting Workshop was conducted at KES SSC English Medium School on 14 October 2026 for 75 students of Grades 7 and 8. The workshop was guided by Ms Tania Fatnani, a Master of Fine Arts graduate with extensive experience in art. Students used their creativity to paint and decorate diyas, which will be lit during the school's Diwali celebrations. Principal Dr Pratibha Jha and teachers enthusiastically participated in the activity. Five Rotaractors from M. L. Dahanukar College assisted in conducting the workshop. The activity was sponsored by Director Rtn Namrata Nulwalla and attended by Director Bijal Merchant and Partner Dr Urvi Kothari.
location: KES SSC English Medium School, Mumbai, Maharashtra
